title: Marserep Marunduk
chord: G · G · Am · F · C · G · F · G
lyrics:
Gaor pe sude humaliang
Sai na demak do muse
Molo didok Jesus sonang
Aha na humotok be
Iluilum do dibilang
Molo na marsak roham

Ndang loasonNa tarhilang ho
Sai papos ma roham
Sai ditangihon Ibana
Na martangiang sude
Jala ditatap mataNa
Na tinobusNa sude

Ipe haposi Ibana
Na paturehon langkam
Sai haholongi Ibana
Na pasonanghon roham
